rules: No catalogue price may end below $5.00 (the floor).
A refund may only be proposed for an order that exists in the clone, whose clone total matches the proposal, that has not already been refunded, and whose status is delivered or returned.
A listing with an open order against it may not be delisted.
The day's surviving proposals may not total more than $4,000.00.
A reprice or delist may only name listings the clone actually carries.
